claims: Riolu Hatch Day takes place on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
Riolu Hatch Day takes place from 11:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.
Riolu Hatch Day duration is 6 hours.
During Riolu Hatch Day, Riolu will hatch more frequently from 2 km eggs obtained from PokéStops.
During Riolu Hatch Day, there are boosted odds to hatch a Shiny Riolu.
Riolu Hatch Day bonuses include half hatch distance.
Riolu Hatch Day bonuses include double hatch candy.
Riolu Hatch Day bonuses include double hatch XP.
2 km eggs obtained during Riolu Hatch Day will predominantly feature Riolu.
Shiny rate for hatching Shiny Riolu is significantly increased during Riolu Hatch Day.
Free Timed Research provides an Incubator.
A $1.99 Paid Ticket offers extra Incubators.
The half hatch distance bonus only applies to eggs placed in an incubator during Riolu Hatch Day hours
